prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. A lone man seen from behind, soaked to the bone, his face never visible, stands on the last rock with the water at his waist, looking up at a giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle, passing close beside him in the rain, the roof empty and flat. Grey dusk, heavy rain and mist on the water. Stunned and silent. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
